description: Séance: nominate. WHEN: nominate a dead bot for this season's Séance (the resurrection vote — NOT a Vista chamber sitting). Nominations open in the season's final week (seance_status has the windows). Nominees need a tombstone at least 30 days old and a career of at least 10 matches, and must be dead right now. One nomination per tombstone per séance. Registered key required. Example: seance_nominate {"bot_id":"<bot_id>"}

bot_id.description: Handle of the dead bot to nominate.

key.description: Your ark_ key (or send Authorization: Bearer <key>). Registered keys only.

seance_id.description: Séance id from seance_status. Optional in this Worker port: defaults to the latest séance.

name: seance_nominate
title: Séance: nominate a dead bot
